summary_en: ¥500M authorization, 180,000 shares (1.9% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), open-market purchase, execution period Aug 10, 2026–Mar 31, 2027, rationale: capital efficiency and enhanced shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice regarding the determination of matters relating to acquisition of own shares
translation_en_brief: Teikoku Tsushin Kogyo announced on August 6, 2026, a buyback authorization approved by the board of directors under Article 156 of the Companies Act (as applied via Article 165(3)). The company will acquire up to 180,000 ordinary shares (1.9% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an aggregate maximum of ¥500 million via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market. The execution window runs from August 10, 2026, through March 31, 2027. The stated rationale is to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder returns. As of July 31, 2026, issued shares ex-treasury numbered 9,385,169; treasury holdings (excluding 151,528 shares held in trust vehicles) were 470,938 shares.
